tests.name: Initialization respects all supported population limits
Same seed and commands reproduce the exact same state
Motion and metabolism use one common time step
Feeding immediately accounts for ALL added pellet matter
Food pool cannot exceed 36 particles
Invalid feeding requests fail without NaN state
Uneaten food decays without losing matter
Dead agents cannot eat
Predation preserves matter even when the predator is almost full
Mortality is idempotent
Immature parents cannot create eggs through direct API calls
Spawning invests parent reserve and conserves matter
Hatching conserves egg matter and produces an actual small fish
Nursery is spatial, not universal invulnerability
Complete extinction does not trigger hidden respawning
Model rejects invalid time steps
Saved state resumes bit-for-bit, including RNG, motion and food
Corrupted balance is rejected
Unknown version is rejected
Non-finite fish values are rejected
Out-of-bounds fish and orientations are rejected
Duplicate IDs are rejected
Malformed history is rejected
Counter corruption is rejected
Day/night and manual light use the same model clock
Jump uses ballistic flight and returns to water
HTML contains the exact audited JS, complete controls and only one scheduler
